description: A large, low‐relief, rectilinear enclosure (~400 m × 200 m) with evenly spaced subtle berms forming a grid of ~50 m‐spaced raised platforms. Oriented precisely N–S/E–W, the edges are straighter and more regular than natural colluvial ridges and align with faint vegetation‐stress patterns in the NIR band.

A narrow, linear causeway or ditch roughly 180 m long, running N–S through the center of anomaly_1. Presents as a slight embankment on the eastern side and a paired depression on the west. Coincides with a line of darker (moister) pixels in the NIR overlay, consistent with subsurface channel retention.
